The full-size keyboard features a **standard layout** with responsive, quiet keys that make typing comfortable and accurate during extended work sessions. Its durable design ensures long-lasting performance for typing reports, emails, projects, and more. Meanwhile, the **compact optical mouse** delivers smooth, precise cursor control with a responsive sensor — ideal for productivity tasks or casual browsing. Both components are engineered for **durability and everyday reliability**, perfect for students, professionals, and anyone needing a dependable input solution. The wired USB-A interface provides a **stable connection** without worrying about batteries or wireless interference. Simply plug it in and go — no pairing or charging required.
